description: Semantic WPF UI Text Block block.

appearance.description: Theme-aware text emphasis role supplied by WPF UI.

fontFamily.description: Font family for this text. Keep Segoe UI Variable Text for body copy; use Segoe UI Variable Display for Windows type-ramp titles at 20 DIP or larger, or override it for the product typography.
fontFamily.default: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI

fontWeight.description: WPF font weight used to emphasize the text.

foreground.description: Optional WPF brush value or resource expression; omit to use the WPF UI Appearance role.

margin.description: Outer WPF Thickness separating the text from adjacent content.

textAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment of text lines within the control.

verticalAlignment.description: Vertical placement within the parent layout slot. Use Center when custom header or compact identity text should align with neighboring controls.

textWrapping.description: Wrapping behavior when text exceeds the available width.
